title: Sweep the learning rate
summary: Sweep gradient descent learning rates on a seeded regression, find the best rate and the first rate that diverges, and compare with 2 over the top eigenvalue.

mutants.finite_only: Marks a run as diverged only when its final loss is not finite, so a finite loss that grows counts as stable.
mutants.first_in_list: Returns the first diverged rate in list order, not the smallest diverged rate.
mutants.hessian_without_two: Uses X^T X / n as the Hessian and forgets the factor 2, so the bound is twice too large.
mutants.no_divergence_filter: Calls np.argmin on the raw final losses, so a NaN run becomes the best rate.
mutants.ties_pick_larger: Picks the larger rate when two runs have the same final loss.
